verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms existence of a dedicated sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) distinct from production, which is the core signal for a safe test environment. However, there's no documentation of the self-serve credential/API key generation process, no confirmation that sandbox registrations are free or fully mirror production behavior, and error responses shown are generic parameter errors rather than a walkthrough. Missing for 10: docs on obtaining API keys self-serve, confirmation sandbox domain registrations don't charge real money, and any independent developer corroboration of sandbox usability.
